t: Back to Basics: Reclaiming Simplicity in a Complex Tech World
s: This article advocates for a return to foundational principles in technology, drawing parallels to the Unix philosophy and its pipe concept for building reliable, simple systems amidst modern complexity. It explores modern interpretations and browser automation tools, emphasizing custom solutions and embracing imperfections.
sub: Unix Philosophy and Pipes as a fundamental pattern
Modern Browser Automation Tools (Puppeteer, Playwright, Selenium)
Embracing Imperfection and Mastery in Development
